verdict.rationale: Whether an inference and training platform lets users keep their data out of model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, no documentation in the pack describes a training opt-out, zero-data-retention setting, or no-training guarantee for customer prompts or data. Community remarks criticizing the privacy policy's broad data-collection language do not establish such a capability, and there is no vendor claim for them to contradict.
